spellbook.finance/limitations: Workspace membership and the seller inventory entitlement remain backend-enforced.
This returns one page. Preserve nextCursor and continue until it is null before totalling a collection, because a partial page under-counts quantity and value.

currentPriceUsd is a market price for the printing and finish, not an offer, a buylist quote, or a channel ask. It is null when no recent quote exists, and a null price contributes nothing to a total.
qtyAvailable excludes copies already listed, pulled or sold. Compare it with qtyOwned instead of assuming they match.

description: Read one page of what a seller's own workspace holds, aggregated to one row per printing, finish and condition. Each row carries card name, set code, collector number, variant label, quantity owned, quantity available, the current unit market price and the resolved minimum-sell floor with the tier that produced it. Call this to answer what is in the collection, what it is worth, what is already listed versus still available, and which rows sit near their floor. It reports holdings; it does not rank them, pick what to sell, or state a listing's live marketplace status.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page, passed back unchanged. Omit to start from the first page.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return, 1 to 500. Omit for the default of 100.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to read holdings for. Required.

name: spellbook_inventory_holdings
